scope: Independent read-only review of final selected records, source/design boundaries and existing numeric evidence. No additional product build, test, consumer, benchmark, merge or release.

product.scope: Existing CI artifact provenance; not public publisher authentication.

priorEvidenceAudit.freezeScope: Read the completed final 16-app/926-file verification receipt and independently checked the identity manifest digest; this review did not repeat the 926-file rehash.

metricBoundaries.allocation: Whole-client managed allocation including DTO, JSON, async and harness; not native heap allocation.
metricBoundaries.cpu: Client process including same-process native execution; excludes PostgreSQL backend CPU.
metricBoundaries.p99: Histogram bucket upper bound for one continuous closed-loop segment per route/provider; no long-repeat confidence interval.
metricBoundaries.memory: Steady sampled RSS/PSS; not heap attribution or process lifetime peak.
metricBoundaries.rejection: No raw Rejected field in all four cells. Normalized zero is a closed-loop default, not measured offered-arrival rejection.
metricBoundaries.owners: Korda has six instrumented native owner classes at zero. Dapper records application-owned logical connections only; instrumentation is asymmetric.
metricBoundaries.databaseVersion: Candidate per-cell databaseVersion remains null; separate version observations are not substituted into those raw fields.
metricBoundaries.attribution: Cumulative baseline/recovered/candidate results do not isolate the latest serializer, a lock, timer, mapper or physical-statement cause.

boundaries: Prepare eagerly compiles at runtime; value snapshot, validation, frame construction and native value transformations remain per execution.
Dynamic query construction submits a bounded complete 22-clause command with typed owner sidecars; C++ remains authoritative.
Exclusive uncaptured private roots up to 4096 bytes use the direct serializer; shared/import/CTE/large cases retain complete-command generic submission.
Model registration, Render, CreateCte, execute, fetch, cancellation and disposal remain separate boundaries; complete command is not one lifetime FFI or network round trip.
Source generation covers static entity/DTO metadata and mapping, not arbitrary build-time Fluent SQL or a general prepared-query parameter binder.
Connection-level physical statement caching is unimplemented.

mechanicalFollowups: Root adds this independent review and its hash to validation.json; validation.json is intentionally excluded from reviewed file hashes to avoid circular binding.
After Plan publication, pin the two current Design final-record links to that exact Plan commit and check those link destinations separately; the semantic text reviewed here must remain unchanged.
Own final document CI is reported separately after publication; no future CI pass is asserted here.
stopInstruction: Record the completed tests and remaining gaps in the existing PRs, do not merge, then stop. No additional optimization or measurement is selected.
